Best Practice:
The property walk is all about surveying the property and assessing its cleanliness, condition, and appearance. Keep the High Touch Areas in mind and
view the property from a guest's perspective. Build notes and create a schedule of work orders to address deﬁcient items identiﬁed on the property walk. This document
serves as a guide and assists in developing a routine for major value drivers of the property's cleanliness and upkeep.
